overview.name: Corgi HIMS 2x Daily ETF
overview.description: The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund that, under ordinary market conditions, seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times (2x) the daily performance of Hims & Hers Health, Inc. ("Hims"). It is non-diversified.
